mapper.select: SELECT CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) FROM DUAL
mapper.sql: T.ID TARGET_ID,T.BATCH_ID,T.PARK_ID, (SELECT MIN(C.RESOURCE_COORD_ID) FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C WHERE C.TARGET_ID=T.ID AND C.RESOURCE_GENERATION=T.OPERATION_VERSION AND C.BINDING_REVISION=0) RESOURCE_COORD_ID, T.RESOURCE_ID,T.OPERATION_VERSION,T.STATE,T.LEASE_TOKEN,T.LEASE_UNTIL,T.DISPATCHED_AT, (SELECT MAX(A.ATTEMPT_NO) FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT A WHERE A.TARGET_ID=T.ID) LATEST_ATTEMPT_NO
mapper.select: SELECT FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T WHERE T.ID=#{targetId}
SELECT T.ID TARGET_ID,T.BATCH_ID,T.PARK_ID,T.RESOURCE_ID,T.OPERATION_VERSION,T.STATE, T.LEASE_TOKEN,T.LEASE_UNTIL,T.DISPATCHED_AT FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T WHERE T.ID=#{targetId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT A.* FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT A WHERE A.ID=#{attemptId} AND A.TARGET_ID=#{targetId} AND A.ATTEMPT_NO=(SELECT MAX(M.ATTEMPT_NO) FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT M WHERE M.TARGET_ID=#{targetId}) FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE WHERE TARGET_ID=#{targetId} AND RESOURCE_COORD_ID=#{resourceId} AND RESOURCE_GENERATION=#{operationVersion} AND BINDING_REVISION=0
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE P WHERE P.ATTEMPT_ID=#{attemptId})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_RESULT_EVENT E WHERE E.ATTEMPT_ID=#{attemptId}) FROM DUAL
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT A SET STATUS='EXPIRED',ERROR_CODE='MANAGEMENT_KNOWN_UNSENT_RETRY', NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT=#{now},UPDATE_TIME=#{now} WHERE A.ID=#{attemptId} AND A.TARGET_ID=#{targetId} AND A.STATUS='CLAIMED' AND A.LEASE_TOKEN=#{leaseToken} AND A.LEASE_UNTIL<=#{now} AND A.TASK_ID IS NULL AND A.EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID IS NULL AND A.EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID IS NULL AND A.DISPATCHED_AT IS NULL AND A.RESULT_EVENT_ID IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE P WHERE P.ATTEMPT_ID=A.ID) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_RESULT_EVENT E WHERE E.ATTEMPT_ID=A.ID)

UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T SET STATE='QUEUED',LEASE_TOKEN=NULL,LEASE_UNTIL=NULL, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT=#{now},FAILURE_REASON=NULL,UPDATE_TIME=#{now} WHERE T.ID=#{targetId} AND T.STATE='EXECUTING' AND T.OPERATION_VERSION=#{operationVersion} AND T.LEASE_TOKEN=#{leaseToken} AND T.LEASE_UNTIL<=#{now} AND T.DISPATCHED_AT IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT A WHERE A.TARGET_ID=T.ID AND A.STATUS='EXPIRED' AND A.LEASE_TOKEN=#{leaseToken} AND A.ATTEMPT_NO=(SELECT MAX(M.ATTEMPT_NO) FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT M WHERE M.TARGET_ID=T.ID))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_GOVERNANCE_ACTION WHERE ACTOR_USER_ID=#{actorUserId} AND IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=#{idempotencyKey} AND SUBJECT_KEY=#{subjectKey}
SELECT ID REVIEW_ID,PARK_ID,ACCESS_TYPE,DEVICE_ID,TASK_KEY,REASON,STATE,CREATE_TIME CREATED_AT FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_REVIEW WHERE PARK_ID=#{parkId} ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID REVIEW_ID,PARK_ID,ACCESS_TYPE,DEVICE_ID,TASK_KEY,REASON,STATE,CREATE_TIME CREATED_AT FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_REVIEW WHERE PARK_ID IS NULL ORDER BY ID
SELECT FROM SMT_AUTH_GOVERNANCE_ACTION A JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T ON T.ID=A.TARGET_ID WHERE A.TARGET_ID=#{targetId} AND T.PARK_ID=#{parkId} ORDER BY A.ID DESC
SELECT ,A.EVIDENCE_BODY FROM SMT_AUTH_GOVERNANCE_ACTION A JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T ON T.ID=A.TARGET_ID WHERE A.ID=#{actionId} AND A.TARGET_ID=#{targetId} AND T.PARK_ID=#{parkId}
